en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a large arched-roof theater building made of wood or corrugated material. The front facade has a central round window with the word "TEATER" displayed inside it, flanked by two smaller circular windows. Long rows of rectangular windows run along the side of the building. In the foreground there is rough grassland, and tree branches frame the upper left corner. Printed captions appear at the bottom describing the location and the photographer/publisher.
